title: Grateful Dead Live at The Spectrum on 1986-03-25
source: MAC; (FOB) Sennheiser 441 > Sony D5 > Maxell XLII-S 90(Set I) Maxell MA-R 90(Set II); Taped by Mark McCue; Transferred, Edited and Mastered by Alex Ford

ai_review.summary: Clear front‑of‑house recording that captures the pre‑Stranger tuning, but a weak first set is rescued by a soaring Scarlet > Fire and Looks Like Rain in the second.
ai_review.review: The FOB tape sounds solid with good clarity and even includes the coveted pre‑Stranger tuning, earning a high rating for the recording. Musically the show falters on a disappointing first set, yet the second set delivers highlights like Scarlet > Fire, Looks Like Rain, and Phil’s novelty vocal on Tom Thumb's. Overall the performance is mixed, reflected in the reviewer’s low show score despite the strong audio capture.

ai_rating.rationale: One detailed review gives a high rating to the recording (≈4‑4.5) but a low show rating (2); weighted average yields an overall ~2.7, indicating an average‑to‑below‑average experience.

recording_quality.technical_notes: FOB capture is clear and crisp, includes the full pre‑Stranger tuning; no major dropouts or muffling noted.

show_quality.setlist_flow: First set drags and feels lifeless, but the second set picks up with a thrilling Scarlet > Fire, dips during Touch of Grey, then rebounds with Looks Like Rain and a fun Tom Thumb's vocal cameo.

band_member_comments.Phil: Phil sings lead on Tom Thumb's, noted as a novelty highlight.
